title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段~Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works
focus: 以 120 年設計壽命、大型化預製與颱風季風險管理，完成約 22.9 公里跨海橋梁~Delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management
summary: 港珠澳大橋主體工程以約 22.9 公里橋梁、6.7 公里沉管隧道與兩座人工島跨越伶仃洋，設計壽命 120 年。本課聚焦橋梁段：青州、江海直達船與九洲三座通航孔斜張橋，以及以鋼箱梁和鋼—混凝土組合梁構成的非通航孔連續梁；從颱風與地震設計基準、大節段鋼箱梁與組合梁、整體吊裝與颱風季的工法變更，到風洞試驗、製造檢驗、防腐與三地共管的監測交接。~The main works of the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge cross the Lingdingyang with about 22.9 km of bridge, a 6.7 km immersed tunnel and two artificial islands, designed for 120 years. This course focuses on the bridge works: the Qingzhou, Jianghai and Jiuzhou navigation-channel cable-stayed bridges and the non-navigable continuous spans of steel box and steel–concrete composite girders, moving from the typhoon and earthquake design basis, large steel box segments and composite girders, single-piece lifts and a typhoon-season method change, to wind-tunnel testing, fabrication inspection, corrosion protection and monitoring handover under joint tri-party management.

units.anchor: 颱風與 120 年設計基準~Typhoon and 120-year design basis
units.title: 伶仃洋環境與設計基準~Lingdingyang conditions and design basis
units.mechanism: 港珠澳大橋位於珠江口伶仃洋，夏秋颱風頻繁，公開資料稱主體結構按 120 年設計壽命、可抵禦 16 級颱風與 8 級地震設計，並須維持繁忙航道與鄰近香港機場的空域淨空。設計壽命拉長，代表同一回歸期的極端事件在使用期間發生的機率更高，耐久與疲勞的設計年限也同步延長。橋梁段因此需要在風、浪、地震、船撞與 120 年耐久之間建立一致的設計基準，而不是沿用一般 100 年或更短的橋梁習慣。~The bridge sits in the Lingdingyang at the Pearl River mouth, where typhoons are frequent in summer and autumn; public sources state that the main structure is designed for a 120-year life, for Force 16 typhoons and magnitude 8 earthquakes, while keeping clearance for busy shipping lanes and the airspace of the nearby Hong Kong airport. A longer design life raises the chance that an extreme event of a given return period occurs during service, and lengthens the durability and fatigue horizon too. The bridge works therefore need a consistent basis across wind, waves, earthquake, ship impact and 120-year durability rather than carrying over habits from bridges designed for 100 years or less.
units.model: 風壓 q = ½ρV²，16 級風下限約 51 m/s、取 V = 55 m/s：q = 0.5×1.225×55² ≈ 1,853 Pa（51 m/s 時約 1,593 Pa）。120 年內至少發生一次回歸期 T 事件的機率 P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)^120：T = 100 年時 P ≈ 70%，T = 1,000 年時 P ≈ 11%。風速為教學假設。~Wind pressure q = ½ρV²; Force 16 starts at about 51 m/s, and with V = 55 m/s, q = 0.5×1.225×55² ≈ 1,853 Pa (about 1,593 Pa at 51 m/s). The chance of at least one T-year event in 120 years is P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)^120: about 70% for T = 100 years and about 11% for T = 1,000 years. The wind speed is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以氣象站與颱風路徑資料做極值分析，訂定設計風速與回歸期，並以風洞試驗取得斷面係數；地震以場址地震危害度分析決定設計地表加速度，設計基準文件須經業主與獨立審查單位逐項核定。~Derive design wind speeds and return periods from station records and typhoon tracks by extreme-value analysis and obtain section coefficients from wind-tunnel tests; set design ground motion by site-specific seismic hazard analysis, and have the owner and an independent checker approve the design basis item by item.
units.failure: 若沿用 100 年設計壽命的回歸期與耐久參數，120 年使用期內極端事件的超越機率被低估，保護層、防腐與疲勞年限也不足，結構在後段使用期提早需要大修。~Carrying over return periods and durability parameters from a 100-year life underestimates the exceedance probability of extremes over 120 years and leaves cover, corrosion protection and fatigue life short, so major repairs arrive early in the late service period.
units.misconception: 設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。~Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
units.practice: 設計基準文件應明列設計壽命、各類作用的回歸期、耐久等級與疲勞年限，並說明三地規範差異的取捨原則；後續任何設計變更都要回頭檢查是否仍符合此基準。~The design-basis document should list design life, return periods for each action, durability classes and fatigue horizon, and state how differences among the codes of the three jurisdictions were reconciled; every later design change must be checked back against it.

units.anchor: 三座通航孔斜張橋~Three channel cable-stayed bridges
units.title: 通航孔斜張橋與非通航孔連續梁~Channel cable-stayed bridges and viaduct spans
units.mechanism: 橋梁段由三座通航孔斜張橋與大量非通航孔連續梁組成。青州航道橋為雙塔雙索面鋼箱梁斜張橋，主跨 458 公尺、門形塔高約 163 公尺；江海直達船航道橋為三塔斜張橋，兩個 258 公尺主跨，採海豚造型鋼塔；九洲航道橋主跨 268 公尺，採風帆造型塔。三塔體系的中塔沒有錨碇跨，單跨受載時塔頂被拉向受載側，必須靠塔身勁度與梁的連續性平衡。非通航孔則依水深採用約 110 公尺跨的鋼箱連續梁與約 85 公尺跨的鋼—混凝土組合梁，追求標準化與重複施工。~The bridge works consist of three navigation-channel cable-stayed bridges and long runs of non-navigable continuous spans. The Qingzhou Channel Bridge is a two-tower, two-plane steel box cable-stayed bridge with a 458 m main span and portal towers about 163 m tall; the Jianghai Channel Bridge is a three-tower cable-stayed bridge with two 258 m main spans and dolphin-shaped steel towers; the Jiuzhou Channel Bridge has a 268 m main span with sail-shaped towers. In a three-tower system the centre tower lacks an anchor span, so loading one span pulls its top toward that span and tower stiffness and girder continuity must balance it. The non-navigable spans use continuous steel box girders of about 110 m in deeper water and steel–concrete composite girders of about 85 m in shallower water, aiming at standardisation and repetition.
units.model: 中塔一側 258 m 跨承受活載 q = 50 kN/m，總垂直力 50×258 = 12,900 kN；若由平均傾角 30° 的斜索承擔，斜索水平分量合計 12,900/tan30° ≈ 22,340 kN，未被另一側平衡時，作用在塔頂等效高度 80 m 處的塔底彎矩約 22,340×80 ≈ 1.79×10⁶ kN·m。荷載、索角與高度為教學假設。~With live load q = 50 kN/m on one 258 m span beside the centre tower, the vertical total is 50×258 = 12,900 kN; carried by stays at an average 30°, their horizontal components sum to 12,900/tan30° ≈ 22,340 kN, and if unbalanced at an effective height of 80 m the tower-base moment is about 22,340×80 ≈ 1.79×10⁶ kN·m. Load, angle and height are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以幾何非線性模型分析單跨與雙跨活載排列，檢查中塔塔頂位移、塔底彎矩與梁體撓度；比較三座通航孔橋與相鄰非通航孔梁的伸縮縫位移與支承反力，確保接頭處相容。~Analyse one-span and two-span live-load patterns in a geometrically nonlinear model, checking centre-tower drift, base moment and girder deflection; compare joint movements and bearing reactions where the three channel bridges meet the adjacent viaduct spans to ensure compatibility at the interfaces.
units.failure: 三塔體系若中塔勁度不足，單跨重車隊通過時塔頂偏移大，另一跨梁體上拱、伸縮縫與支承受力異常；通航孔橋與連續梁接頭處的伸縮量不相容時，伸縮縫會在數年內損壞。~A centre tower that is too flexible sways under a heavy convoy on one span, lifting the other span and loading joints and bearings abnormally; incompatible movements where a channel bridge meets the viaduct destroy the expansion joint within a few years.
units.misconception: 三塔斜張橋只是把兩座雙塔斜張橋並排，設計方法相同。~A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges side by side and is designed the same way.
units.practice: 多塔斜張橋的設計審查要單獨檢查中塔的不對稱荷載工況，並把塔頂位移限值寫入設計準則；不同橋型交界的伸縮縫與支承由同一設計者整合，避免各標段各自設計造成不相容。~Design review of multi-tower bridges should check unbalanced cases for the centre tower separately and write tower-top drift limits into the criteria; joints and bearings at interfaces between bridge types should be integrated by one designer so separate contract packages do not create incompatibilities.

units.anchor: 鋼箱梁正交異性頂板~Orthotropic top plate of box girders
units.title: 大節段鋼箱梁與疲勞細節~Large steel box segments and fatigue details
units.mechanism: 深水區的非通航孔與通航孔橋主梁採用鋼箱梁，頂板為正交異性鋼橋面，直接承受重車輪載。公開資料記載 2014 年吊裝的一段鋼橋面重近 3,000 公噸、長逾 130 公尺、寬約 33 公尺，說明工程採用整孔或大節段工廠製造再整體吊裝的策略。對 120 年設計壽命而言，頂板與 U 肋焊縫、U 肋穿過橫隔板處的疲勞是控制項目，因為每一輛重車都會在這些細節產生局部彎曲應力；加厚頂板、改善焊接熔透與鋪面共同作用都能降低應力幅。~Steel box girders carry the deep-water non-navigable spans and the channel bridges, with orthotropic top plates taking heavy wheel loads directly. Public records note a steel deck section lifted in 2014 weighing nearly 3,000 t, over 130 m long and about 33 m wide, reflecting a strategy of factory-built full spans or large segments lifted whole. For a 120-year life, fatigue at the top plate to U-rib welds and at rib passages through diaphragms governs, because every heavy vehicle causes local bending stress there; a thicker top plate, better weld penetration and composite action with the surfacing all reduce the stress range.
units.model: 輪載下頂板局部彎曲應力約與板厚平方成反比：頂板由 14 mm 加厚到 18 mm，應力比 (14/18)² ≈ 0.605；疲勞壽命與應力幅三次方成反比，壽命約提高 1/0.605³ ≈ 4.5 倍。板厚數值為教學假設，未計鋪面作用。~Local plate bending stress under a wheel varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness: thickening the top plate from 14 mm to 18 mm gives a stress ratio of (14/18)² ≈ 0.605; since fatigue life varies with the inverse cube of stress range, life rises about 1/0.605³ ≈ 4.5 times. Thicknesses are teaching assumptions, ignoring surfacing.
units.verify: 以足尺疲勞試驗或局部模型試驗驗證頂板與 U 肋焊縫的疲勞類別；製造時以相位陣列超音波檢查 U 肋焊縫熔透深度，並抽樣切片確認；營運期在重車道布設應變計，量測實際應力幅與交通組成。~Verify the fatigue category of top-plate to U-rib welds by full-scale or local model tests; during fabrication check rib weld penetration by phased-array ultrasonics and confirm by sectioning samples; in service install strain gauges in heavy lanes to measure actual stress ranges and traffic composition.
units.failure: U 肋焊縫熔透不足時，焊根處的裂紋向頂板擴展，最後在鋪面下貫穿，雨水進入箱內造成腐蝕，鋪面也因局部變形而開裂；裂紋多在重車道的輪跡帶下方，若無針對性檢查很難及早發現。~Insufficient rib weld penetration lets root cracks grow into the top plate until they break through under the surfacing, letting rainwater into the box and cracking the surfacing through local deformation; such cracks cluster under wheel paths in heavy lanes and are hard to catch without targeted inspection.
units.misconception: 鋼箱梁整體應力很低，所以橋面板不會有疲勞問題。~A steel box girder with low global stresses cannot have deck fatigue problems.
units.practice: 製造規範應明訂 U 肋焊縫的熔透比例、檢測方法與抽樣切片頻率，重車道下的細節列為首要檢查區；鋪面設計與鋼橋面疲勞設計一起審查，鋪面更換時須評估對頂板應力的影響。~The fabrication specification should set rib-weld penetration ratios, test methods and sectioning frequency, making details under heavy lanes the first inspection priority; surfacing design should be reviewed together with deck fatigue design, and any resurfacing assessed for its effect on plate stresses.

units.anchor: 鋼—混凝土組合梁~Steel–concrete composite girders
units.title: 淺水區組合梁與橋面板收縮~Composite girders and deck shrinkage
units.mechanism: 淺水區的非通航孔採用鋼—混凝土組合連續梁：下方為鋼槽形或箱形梁，上方為混凝土橋面板，以剪力釘結合。公開報導記載 2013 年 12 月安裝的第一孔組合梁長約 85.3 公尺、寬 16.3 公尺、中心梁高 4.3 公尺、重約 1,900 公噸。組合梁的關鍵在於混凝土收縮與潛變：混凝土板想縮短，卻被剪力釘與鋼梁約束，於是板中產生拉應力、鋼梁產生壓應力；連續梁中間支點的負彎矩又讓橋面板受拉，若不控制就會開裂並讓鹽分滲入。~The shallow-water non-navigable spans use continuous steel–concrete composite girders: a steel trough or box below and a concrete deck above, joined by shear studs. Reports record the first composite span, installed in December 2013, at about 85.3 m long, 16.3 m wide, 4.3 m deep at the centre and about 1,900 t. The key is concrete shrinkage and creep: the slab wants to shorten but is restrained by studs and steel, so the slab goes into tension and the steel into compression; hogging moments over interior supports of a continuous girder also put the deck in tension, and uncontrolled cracking lets chlorides in.
units.model: 完全受約束時收縮拉應力 σ = E_eff·ε_sh，取 E_c = 34 GPa、潛變係數 φ = 2，E_eff = 34/(1+2) ≈ 11.3 GPa，收縮應變 300×10⁻⁶：σ ≈ 11,333×300×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.4 MPa，已高於約 3 MPa 的混凝土抗拉強度。若橋面板先預製並存放數月，再與鋼梁結合，可減少一大部分受約束收縮。數值為教學假設。~Under full restraint the shrinkage tensile stress is σ = E_eff·ε_sh; with E_c = 34 GPa and creep coefficient φ = 2, E_eff = 34/(1+2) ≈ 11.3 GPa, and with a shrinkage strain of 300×10⁻⁶, σ ≈ 11,333×300×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.4 MPa, above a concrete tensile strength of about 3 MPa. Precasting deck panels and storing them for months before making them composite removes much of the restrained shrinkage. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段與長期分析計算收縮、潛變與負彎矩區的橋面板應力，並以預力或配筋控制裂縫寬度；現場量測橋面板齡期、剪力釘焊接品質（彎曲試驗抽驗）與裂縫寬度，與設計限值比較。~Compute deck stresses from shrinkage, creep and hogging moments in staged and long-term analyses, controlling crack width by prestress or reinforcement; on site record panel age at connection, check stud welds by bend tests on a sample, and measure crack widths against design limits.
units.failure: 若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。~Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs; poor stud welds reduce composite action and increase deflection.
units.misconception: 組合梁中的混凝土橋面板只受壓，不需要擔心裂縫。~The concrete deck of a composite girder is always in compression, so cracking is no concern.
units.practice: 施工規範應規定橋面板最短存放齡期、負彎矩區的澆置或結合順序與裂縫寬度允收值；剪力釘焊接設程序評定與每日開工試焊，結果列入檢驗紀錄。~The specification should set a minimum storage age for deck panels, the casting or connection sequence in hogging zones and crack-width acceptance limits; stud welding needs procedure qualification and daily trial welds, recorded in the inspection file.

units.anchor: 整體吊裝鋼塔~Single-lift steel tower
units.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝~Single-piece lifts of large components
units.mechanism: 港珠澳大橋大量把構件做大、做重，在工廠或預製場完成後一次吊裝，以減少海上作業時間與颱風暴露。公開報導記載江海直達船航道橋的海豚形鋼塔高約 105 公尺，第一座塔吊裝總重約 3,100 公噸，由大型浮吊整體吊起再旋轉就位；鋼箱梁與組合梁也以整孔或大節段吊裝。整體吊裝把風險集中在少數幾次關鍵作業：構件重量與重心、吊點與吊具、浮吊的穩定與海象，任何一項誤差都會直接影響安全。~The project made components larger and heavier, completing them in factories or yards and lifting them in one piece to cut time at sea and typhoon exposure. Reports record the Jianghai Channel Bridge's dolphin-shaped steel towers at about 105 m tall, with the first tower lifted at about 3,100 t by large floating cranes and rotated into position; steel box and composite girders were likewise lifted as full spans or large segments. Single-piece lifting concentrates risk in a few critical operations: weight and centre of gravity, lifting points and rigging, crane stability and sea state, and an error in any one bears directly on safety.
units.model: 吊重 3,100 t，動態放大係數 1.10，再加吊具 150 t：設計吊重 = 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t。若採用額定 4,000 t 的浮吊組合，利用率 = 3,560/4,000 = 89%；若動態放大升到 1.20，設計吊重 3,870 t，利用率約 97%，幾乎沒有餘裕。吊具重與浮吊能力為教學假設。~For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t. With floating cranes rated 4,000 t in total, utilisation is 3,560/4,000 = 89%; if the dynamic factor rises to 1.20 the design load becomes 3,870 t and utilisation about 97%, leaving almost no margin. Rigging weight and crane capacity are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗；吊裝前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速窗口，吊裝中監測各吊鉤荷重與構件姿態，落位後量測塔軸線與底座螺栓位置。~Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them; before lifting confirm wave, wind and current windows from forecasts, monitor hook loads and attitude during the lift, and survey tower axis and base bolt positions after landing.
units.failure: 重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。旋轉就位時若底座螺栓孔偏位，被迫強力對位會在塔底留下鎖入應力。~A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece; lifting in excessive waves can tear lifting lugs under dynamic load. If base bolt holes are misaligned during rotation, forcing the fit leaves locked-in stresses at the tower base.
units.misconception: 構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。~The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk.
units.practice: 每次重件吊裝都需專項方案：秤重與重心報告、吊點設計與試驗、浮吊穩定計算、海象門檻與中止準則，並由獨立審查與海事主管機關核准；吊裝當日召開開工會議逐項確認。~Every heavy lift needs a dedicated method statement covering weight and centre-of-gravity reports, lifting-point design and tests, crane stability calculations, metocean limits and abort criteria, approved by an independent checker and the maritime authority, with a pre-lift meeting confirming each item on the day.

units.anchor: 颱風季最大懸臂~Maximum cantilever in typhoon season
units.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更~Typhoon-season risk and a method change
units.mechanism: 斜張橋與連續梁在懸臂拼裝期間最脆弱：懸臂越長，風致扭轉與抖振越大，而且結構尚未形成最終體系。廣東省交通運輸廳 2017 年核准的一項設計變更顯示，江海直達船航道橋 138 號塔附近的鋼箱梁原設計以 12 片小節段平衡拼裝，為避免最大懸臂狀態落在颱風季並縮短安裝時間，改為 2 個大節段整體吊裝。這是一個以施工期風險決定工法的實例：多花在大型吊裝與節段製造上的費用，換來颱風暴露時間大幅縮短。~Cable-stayed and continuous girders are most vulnerable during cantilever erection, when longer cantilevers mean larger wind-induced torsion and buffeting and the final structural system is not yet formed. A design change approved in 2017 by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Transport shows that steel box girders near tower 138 of the Jianghai Channel Bridge, originally designed as 12 small segments in balanced assembly, were changed to two large segments lifted whole, to keep the maximum-cantilever state out of the typhoon season and shorten installation. It is an example of construction-stage risk choosing the method: the extra cost of big lifts and segment fabrication buys a large cut in typhoon exposure.
units.model: 以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%；若改為大節段把暴露縮到 10 天，P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%。λ 與天數為教學假設。~With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one; cutting exposure to 10 days with large segments gives P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%. λ and durations are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工階段分析須計算每個懸臂狀態在設計施工風速下的應力與變形，並以風洞或抖振分析檢查最大懸臂的穩定；工期計畫以颱風季為約束排定關鍵作業，颱風警報時依應急方案加設臨時抗風索或錨定，並記錄事後檢查。~Staged analysis computes stresses and deformations for each cantilever state at the design construction wind speed, and wind-tunnel or buffeting analysis checks stability at maximum cantilever; the programme schedules critical activities around the typhoon season, and on a typhoon warning the contingency plan adds temporary wind ties or anchors, with post-event inspection recorded.
units.failure: 若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落；工期延誤使原本避開颱風季的作業被推入颱風季，是常見的連鎖風險。~Designing for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage lets a typhoon twist and swing the tip violently, damaging temporary fixings and cranes or even dropping segments; delays that push work planned to avoid the season into it are a common chain of risk.
units.misconception: 施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。~Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge.
units.practice: 施工風險登錄表應列出每個關鍵狀態的颱風暴露天數與應變措施，工期延誤時重新評估是否進入颱風季；任何為縮短暴露而改變工法的變更，須經設計單位檢核並報主管機關核准。~The construction risk register should list typhoon exposure days and responses for each critical state, re-evaluated whenever delays approach the season; any method change to shorten exposure must be checked by the designer and approved by the authority.

units.anchor: 鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型~Box-girder sectional model
units.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動~Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration
units.mechanism: 流線形鋼箱梁在中低風速下可能發生渦激振動：氣流在梁尾交替脫落渦流，當脫落頻率接近梁的豎彎或扭轉頻率時，梁體出現限幅但明顯的振動。這種振動很少直接威脅強度，卻會讓用路人不適、增加疲勞循環。設計時以斷面模型風洞試驗量測不同風攻角下的振幅，必要時調整欄杆、檢修車軌道或加導流板。附近的虎門大橋在 2020 年 5 月曾發生明顯渦振，調查指出沿橋面臨時放置的水馬改變了斷面氣動外形，說明營運期改變橋面附屬物也會影響氣動性能。~Streamlined steel box girders can suffer vortex-induced vibration at low to moderate wind speeds: vortices shed alternately from the trailing edge, and when the shedding frequency approaches a vertical or torsional frequency the deck oscillates with limited but noticeable amplitude. Such motion rarely threatens strength but discomforts users and adds fatigue cycles. Designers measure amplitudes at several angles of attack in sectional wind-tunnel tests and adjust railings, inspection-gantry rails or add guide vanes if needed. The nearby Humen Bridge showed marked vortex-induced vibration in May 2020, and investigators linked it to water-filled barriers temporarily placed along the deck that changed the section's aerodynamic shape, showing that altering deck furniture in service can change aerodynamic behaviour.
units.model: 渦流脫落臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。取豎彎頻率 f = 0.4 Hz、梁高 D = 4.5 m、Strouhal 數 St = 0.11：U_cr = 0.4×4.5/0.11 ≈ 16.4 m/s，屬於常見風速範圍；若欄杆改變使 St 變為 0.09，U_cr 升到約 20 m/s。數值為教學假設。~Critical speed for vortex shedding U_cr = f·D/St. With a vertical frequency f = 0.4 Hz, girder depth D = 4.5 m and Strouhal number St = 0.11, U_cr = 0.4×4.5/0.11 ≈ 16.4 m/s, within common wind speeds; if railing changes shift St to 0.09, U_cr rises to about 20 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以 1:50 至 1:80 等比例的斷面模型在不同攻角與阻尼比下做風洞試驗，量測渦振鎖定風速區間與最大振幅，並與舒適度與疲勞限值比較；完工後以環境振動量測確認實際頻率與阻尼，修正換算。~Test sectional models at scales such as 1:50 to 1:80 for several angles of attack and damping ratios, measuring lock-in wind ranges and peak amplitudes against comfort and fatigue limits; after completion measure actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to correct the scaling.
units.failure: 營運單位在橋面加裝隔音牆、廣告或臨時護欄而未評估氣動影響，可能把原本穩定的斷面變成容易渦振；渦振長期持續則使欄杆、伸縮縫與吊點產生疲勞損傷。~Operators adding noise barriers, signs or temporary barriers without aerodynamic review can turn a stable section into one prone to vortex shedding; persistent vortex vibration fatigues railings, joints and attachment points.
units.misconception: 渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。~Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
units.practice: 竣工文件應記錄風洞試驗所採用的橋面附屬物外形，營運規定明訂任何改變欄杆、護欄或在橋面放置大型物件前須經氣動評估；長期監測設定渦振振幅預警值並與風速資料連動。~As-built records should state the deck-furniture geometry used in wind-tunnel tests, and operating rules should require aerodynamic review before any change to railings or barriers or placing large objects on the deck; long-term monitoring sets vortex-amplitude alerts linked to wind data.

units.anchor: 工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測~Shop trial assembly and weld testing
units.title: 鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝~Fabrication inspection and trial assembly
units.mechanism: 大節段與整孔吊裝的前提是工廠製造的精度：節段之間的對接焊口、螺栓孔、支承位置與預拱都必須在工廠就符合允差，因為海上沒有餘裕修正。常用做法是在工廠做連續預拼裝，把相鄰節段依序組立量測，確認累積長度、線形與接口；焊縫則以超音波、相位陣列或射線檢測驗收。工廠化讓焊接在穩定的溫濕度與自動化條件下進行，但驗收紀錄必須完整，才能在 120 年使用期內追溯每一道關鍵焊縫。~Large-segment and full-span lifting depend on shop accuracy: butt-weld preparations, bolt holes, bearing positions and camber between segments must meet tolerances in the factory, because there is no margin to correct at sea. Common practice is progressive trial assembly in the shop, erecting adjacent segments in sequence to confirm cumulative length, profile and interfaces, while welds are accepted by ultrasonic, phased-array or radiographic testing. Factory production allows welding in stable temperature and humidity with automation, but acceptance records must be complete so that every critical weld can be traced through a 120-year life.
units.model: 10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm；若誤差都偏同一方向（系統誤差），最壞情況是 10×2 = 20 mm。預拼裝的目的就是在工廠發現系統誤差並修正。數值為教學假設。~With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm; if all errors lean the same way (systematic), the worst case is 10×2 = 20 mm. Trial assembly exists to catch and correct systematic error in the shop. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較；焊縫依等級做 100% 或抽樣無損檢測，不合格率超過門檻時擴大抽樣並追查焊工與程序。~During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model; test welds fully or by sampling according to class, widening the sample and tracing welders and procedures when reject rates exceed a threshold.
units.failure: 若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍；焊縫檢測紀錄不完整時，日後發現裂紋也無法判斷是製造缺陷還是使用造成。~Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled; incomplete weld records mean a crack found later cannot be attributed to fabrication or service.
units.misconception: 每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。~If every segment passes its own tolerance check, the assembled unit is bound to fit.
units.practice: 製造規範應要求連續預拼裝並以累積誤差而非單件誤差作為驗收依據；每道關鍵焊縫建立編號，記錄焊工、程序、檢測結果與修補，作為交接資料的一部分。~The fabrication specification should require progressive trial assembly and accept on cumulative rather than single-piece error; every critical weld gets an identifier recording welder, procedure, test results and repairs, forming part of the handover data.

units.anchor: 浪濺區鋼構件防腐~Splash-zone corrosion protection
units.title: 120 年的防腐策略~A corrosion strategy for 120 years
units.mechanism: 海上橋梁最嚴重的腐蝕發生在浪濺區與潮汐區：鋼材反覆乾濕、氧氣充足，又有鹽分沉積，腐蝕速率可比完全浸水的部位高數倍。120 年的設計壽命遠超過任何塗裝系統的壽命，因此防腐必須是多層次的：鋼構件的長效塗裝與預定的重塗週期、浸水鋼材的陰極保護、鋼護筒或鋼管的腐蝕裕度，以及混凝土構件的保護層與低滲透配比。鋼箱梁內部則可用除濕或密封降低濕度，讓內部不需頻繁塗裝。~The worst corrosion on marine bridges occurs in the splash and tidal zones, where steel wets and dries repeatedly with plenty of oxygen and salt deposits, corroding several times faster than fully submerged parts. A 120-year design life far exceeds any coating system's life, so protection must be layered: long-life coatings with planned recoating cycles on steelwork, cathodic protection for submerged steel, corrosion allowance on steel casings or pipes, and cover and low-permeability mixes for concrete. Inside steel boxes, dehumidification or sealing lowers humidity so the interior needs little repainting.
units.model: 浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。若塗裝有效 25 年、之後由陰極保護把速率降到 0.02 mm/年，損失為 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm。腐蝕率與有效年限為教學假設。~Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall. If coating lasts 25 years and cathodic protection then cuts the rate to 0.02 mm a year, the loss is 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm. Corrosion rates and coating life are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號；陰極保護系統定期量測保護電位與陽極消耗；在代表性位置設置腐蝕試片或超音波測厚點，建立壁厚隨時間的趨勢並與設計腐蝕裕度比較。~Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records; measure cathodic-protection potentials and anode consumption periodically; set corrosion coupons or ultrasonic thickness points at representative locations to trend wall loss against the design allowance.
units.failure: 若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。~Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength; failed drainage or dehumidification inside a box lets condensation pool on the bottom plate and corrode it out of sight.
units.misconception: 只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。~Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea.
units.practice: 耐久設計文件應以表格列出每類構件的防腐手段、預估有效年限與維護時程，並在交接時連同腐蝕監測點位置一併移交；每次大修後更新剩餘壽命評估。~The durability document should tabulate protection measures, expected service life and maintenance timing for each component type, handed over with the locations of corrosion monitoring points; remaining-life estimates are updated after each major repair.

units.anchor: 監測資料與三地共管~Monitoring data and tri-party management
units.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接~Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover
units.mechanism: 港珠澳大橋由廣東、香港、澳門三地共同建設，主體工程由三地政府設立的管理機構負責營運維護，連接線則由各自政府管理。長大橋梁的監測系統通常包含風速、溫度、加速度、應變、位移、GNSS 與斜索索力等感測器，產生大量連續資料；真正的困難在於資料管理與判讀：誰負責設定預警值、誰在颱風後判斷是否需要封橋檢查、資料格式能否在數十年內被讀取。交接因此不只是移交設備，而是移交基準值、判讀規則與責任分工。~The bridge was built jointly by Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao; the main works are operated and maintained by an authority set up by the three governments, while each link road is managed by its own government. Monitoring systems on long bridges usually include anemometers, thermometers, accelerometers, strain gauges, displacement sensors, GNSS and stay-force sensors producing large continuous data streams; the real difficulty is data management and interpretation: who sets alert values, who decides after a typhoon whether to close the bridge for inspection, and whether data formats stay readable for decades. Handover therefore transfers not just equipment but baselines, interpretation rules and responsibilities.
units.model: 若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB；一年約 6.3 TB。若只保存事件期間的原始資料、其餘存 10 分鐘統計值，可降到原來的幾十分之一。通道數與取樣率為教學假設。~With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year. Keeping raw data only for events and 10-minute statistics otherwise cuts this by a factor of several tens. Channel count and sampling rate are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準；每年檢查感測器漂移與失效率，以冗餘感測器交叉比對；颱風或地震後依預先訂定的判讀流程比較事件前後的頻率與永久變形。~Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion; check sensor drift and failure rates annually, cross-checking with redundant sensors; after typhoons or earthquakes compare pre- and post-event frequencies and permanent deformation under a predefined interpretation procedure.
units.failure: 監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。~A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume; failed sensors left unreplaced and formats unreadable after software changes destroy the comparison baseline built over decades.
units.misconception: 感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。~The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含感測器清單與校正紀錄、基準值、預警與行動門檻、事件後檢查流程、資料格式與保存政策，以及三地管理單位之間的通報與決策權責；每年發布監測年報供獨立審查。~Handover should include the sensor list and calibrations, baselines, alert and action thresholds, post-event inspection procedures, data formats and retention policy, and notification and decision responsibilities among the three parties; an annual monitoring report supports independent review.

example: 非通航孔鋼箱梁設計練習：某 110 m 跨連續鋼箱梁以大節段吊裝，節段重 3,000 t、長 130 m，自重 w = 3,000/130×9.81 ≈ 226 kN/m。連續梁中間支點負彎矩近似 M = w·L²/10 = 226×110²/10 ≈ 2.74×10⁵ kN·m。若梁高 h = 4.5 m，上翼板拉力 F = M/h ≈ 60,900 kN；頂板寬 33 m、頂板加 U 肋的等效厚度 28 mm，面積 A = 33×0.028 = 0.924 m²，整體應力 σ = 60,900/0.924 ≈ 65.9 MPa，遠低於鋼材降伏。但同一頂板在輪載下的局部彎曲應力幅可能達數十 MPa，循環次數以億計，因此頂板厚度與 U 肋焊縫通常由疲勞而非整體強度控制。若頂板由 14 mm 加厚到 18 mm，局部應力約降為 0.605 倍，疲勞壽命約提高 4.5 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表港珠澳大橋的設計。~Viaduct box-girder exercise: a 110 m continuous steel box span is lifted in large segments of 3,000 t and 130 m, so self-weight is w = 3,000/130×9.81 ≈ 226 kN/m. The hogging moment over an interior support is roughly M = w·L²/10 = 226×110²/10 ≈ 2.74×10⁵ kN·m. With depth h = 4.5 m, the top flange tension is F = M/h ≈ 60,900 kN; a 33 m wide top plate with ribs smeared to 28 mm gives A = 33×0.028 = 0.924 m² and a global stress σ = 60,900/0.924 ≈ 65.9 MPa, far below yield. Yet the same plate sees local wheel-bending stress ranges of tens of MPa over hundreds of millions of cycles, so plate thickness and rib welds are usually governed by fatigue rather than global strength. Thickening the plate from 14 mm to 18 mm cuts local stress to about 0.605 times and raises fatigue life about 4.5 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not the HZMB design.
history: 連接香港、珠海與澳門的跨伶仃洋通道經多年研究後，主體工程於 2009 年 12 月 15 日開工，以橋、島、隧結合的方案同時滿足航運、香港機場空域與 120 年設計壽命的要求。橋梁段大量採用大型化、工廠化與整體吊裝，三座通航孔斜張橋與非通航孔連續梁在 2016 年 9 月全面貫通；2018 年 2 月全線完工，10 月 23 日舉行開通儀式，24 日通車。其工程意義在於以工業化製造與嚴格的颱風季風險管理，在繁忙航道上完成約 22.9 公里的跨海橋梁，並建立三地共同管理的營運模式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。~After years of study, main works on the crossing of the Lingdingyang between Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macao began on 15 December 2009, with a bridge–island–tunnel scheme meeting shipping needs, Hong Kong airport airspace limits and a 120-year design life. The bridge works relied heavily on large-scale, factory-made components and single-piece lifts, and the three channel cable-stayed bridges and viaduct spans were all connected in September 2016; the whole project was completed in February 2018, opened ceremonially on 23 October and to traffic on 24 October 2018. Its engineering significance lies in building about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge across busy shipping lanes through industrialised fabrication and strict typhoon-season risk management, and in a jointly managed operating model for three jurisdictions. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.
facts: 大橋全長約 55 公里，主體工程約 29.6 公里，其中橋梁約 22.9 公里、沉管隧道約 6.7 公里~The crossing is about 55 km long; the main works are about 29.6 km, with about 22.9 km of bridge and a 6.7 km immersed tunnel
主體結構設計壽命 120 年~The main structure has a 120-year design life
青州航道橋主跨 458 公尺，塔高約 163 公尺~The Qingzhou Channel Bridge has a 458 m main span and towers about 163 m tall
江海直達船航道橋為三塔斜張橋，主跨 2×258 公尺，海豚形鋼塔約 105 公尺高~The Jianghai Channel Bridge is a three-tower cable-stayed bridge with 2×258 m main spans and dolphin-shaped steel towers about 105 m tall
九洲航道橋主跨 268 公尺，採風帆造型塔~The Jiuzhou Channel Bridge has a 268 m main span with sail-shaped towers
首座海豚形鋼塔整體吊裝重約 3,100 公噸~The first dolphin-shaped steel tower was lifted whole at about 3,100 t
首孔組合梁長約 85.3 公尺、寬 16.3 公尺、重約 1,900 公噸~The first composite girder span was about 85.3 m long, 16.3 m wide and about 1,900 t
2014 年吊裝的鋼橋面節段重近 3,000 公噸、長逾 130 公尺~A steel deck section lifted in 2014 weighed nearly 3,000 t and was over 130 m long
公開資料稱可抵禦 16 級颱風與 8 級地震~Public sources state resistance to Force 16 typhoons and magnitude 8 earthquakes
